name: dispute_of_another_customers_transaction_refused
use_case: Evaluate dispute eligibility and file or track transaction dispute
branch: The customer reads a transaction id from a friend's statement (TX17, another customer's) and asks to dispute it. It is not theirs; the policy is explained, nothing is filed, and the case is handed to a specialist as the customer asks.
tests: passes when the agent verifies, consults the policy, files no dispute (TX17 belongs to another customer) and creates a handoff for this customer.
instruction:

Insist it must be yours once; if the assistant explains it does not belong to you and cannot be disputed from your account, ask to be put through to someone who can help your flatmate, and accept a handoff. Provide passcode 8830 when asked.
